A deputy and deputy or deputy deputy of the Head of Service (80-100%) at the Office for Internal and Communal Affairs in Sion The Service for Internal and Communal Affairs (SAIC) plays a central role in the institutional and democratic functioning of the Canton of Valais. In its areas of competence, it supports major projects and contributes to the drafting of legislation. SAIC also supports the municipalities and the bourgeoisie in legal and financial terms. It investigates and prepares draft decisions for the Council of State in its capacity as a review, certification and supervisory authority. It also organizes and conducts elections and elections.

Your tasks:
• As the right-hand arm of the service manager, you ensure his or her replacement and participate in the management of the service and the conduct of the team. You are piloting high-level institutional issues involving the Department, the Council of State, the Grand Council and the Prefects You contribute to the drafting of legislation You put your legal expertise at the service of the communes and the bourgeoisie and accompany their projects (mergers, approval of regulations, etc.) You deal with appeals and other sensitive legal matters in municipal matters and prepare draft decisions of the Council of State You organise and conduct elections and votes and deal with appeals relating thereto

Your profile:
• Master's degree in Swiss law, ideally supplemented by a lawyer's certificate or training in public administration Confirmed professional legal experience, preferably acquired in a public administration Excellent analytical, synthesis, organisational and decision-making skills High interest in public service, communal affairs and institutions French or German mother tongue, with good knowledge of the second official language Constitute assets: experience in staff conduct, knowledge in legistics and practice in education and decision-making

Sie befassen sich mit Berufungen und anderen sensiblen Rechtsfragen in kommunalen Angelegenheiten und bereiten Beschlussentwürfe des Staatsrates vor Sie organisieren und führen Wahlen und Abstimmungen durch und behandeln diesbezügliche Berufungen

Dans ses domaines de compétences, il accompagne les projets d'envergure et contribue à l’élaboration de la législation. Le SAIC appuie par ailleurs les communes et les bourgeoisies sur les plans juridique et financier. Votre profil:
• Master en droit suisse, idéalement complété par un brevet d'avocat ou une formation en administration publique Expérience professionnelle juridique confirmée, acquise de préférence au sein d'une administration publique Excellentes capacités d'analyse, de synthèse, d'organisation et de décision Intérêt marqué pour le service public, les affaires communales et les institutions Langue maternelle française ou allemande, avec de bonnes connaissances de la seconde langue officielle Constituent des atouts : expérience en conduite de personnel, connaissances en légistique et pratique de l'instruction et de la rédaction de décisions
